sentences.en: My friend Patrick has always been a fanatical opponent of Mr. Lane's party.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友帕特里克一直是莱恩先生的政党的狂热反对者。

sentences.en: After the elections, Patrick went to the former Prime Minister's house.
sentences.zh: 大选之后，帕特里克去了前首相的家。

sentences.en: A policeman on duty told him that the ex-Prime Minister had gone abroad.
sentences.zh: 一名值班警察告诉他，自从落选以后，前首相就出国了。

sentences.en: The same policeman was walking on the pavement outside and gave him the same answer.
sentences.zh: 还是那名警察，正在外面的人行道上踱步，给了他同样的回答。

sentences.en: The ex-Prime Minister had been arrested and sent to prison.
sentences.zh: 前首相已被逮捕并送进了监狱。

article.en: The former Prime Minister, Mr. Wentworth Lane, was defeated in the recent elections.
article.zh: 前任首相温特沃斯·莱恩先生在最近的大选中被击败。

article.en: He is now retiring from political life and has gone abroad.
article.zh: 他现在即将退出政坛，并且已经出国。

article.en: My friend Patrick has always been a fanatical opponent of Mr. Lane's party.
article.zh: 我的朋友帕特里克一直是莱恩先生的政党的狂热反对者。

article.en: After the elections, Patrick went to the former Prime Minister's house.
article.zh: 大选之后，帕特里克去了前首相的家。

article.en: A policeman on duty told him that the ex-Prime Minister had gone abroad.
article.zh: 一名值班警察告诉他，自从落选以后，前首相就出国了。

article.en: On the following day, Patrick went to the house again and asked the same question.
article.zh: 第二天，帕特里克又去了那座房子，问了同样的问题。

article.en: The same policeman was walking on the pavement outside and gave him the same answer.
article.zh: 还是那名警察，正在外面的人行道上踱步，给了他同样的回答。

article.en: Patrick visited the house once more the day after.
article.zh: 第三天，帕特里克又一次去了那座房子。

article.en: This time the policeman was delighted to tell him the latest news.
article.zh: 这一次警察很高兴地告诉了他最新的消息。

article.en: The ex-Prime Minister had been arrested and sent to prison.
article.zh: 前首相已被逮捕并送进了监狱。
